The core challenge is disentangling confounded variables: hunger modulates speed but not necessarily strategy; pigmentation correlates with adrenal function which impacts stress responses; sex hormones influence motivation but not necessarily pure learning. Modern computational approaches must account for these latent factors via hierarchical probabilistic models. Failure occurs when assuming independence between biological moderators leads to replicability crises.
